add_reminder: add a new reminder with a title, due datetime, and description to the ReminderApp
add_recurring_reminder: add a recurring reminder with repetition unit and value to the ReminderApp
delete_reminder: delete a reminder by its ID and all its repetitions from the ReminderApp
get_due_reminders: get all reminders that are due based on the current time from the ReminderApp
get_all_reminders: get all reminders stored in the ReminderApp reminder system
